1.structure_ar: جملة القسم: واو القسم + المُقسَم به (العصر)، متعلقان بفعل محذوف تقديره: أُقسِمُ.
1.structure_en: Oath clause: the wāw of oath + the thing sworn by (al-ʿaṣr), attached to an implied verb "I swear".

segments.desc_en: A preposition used for swearing an oath: "By…"
Moon-letter lām: the lām is pronounced

sarf.root_meaning: to press, squeeze out; an age or epoch; late afternoon
sarf.word_type_en: Triliteral noun (originally the verbal noun of ʿaṣara, "to press")

irab.ar: الواو: واو القسم، حرف جر مبني على الفتح. العصرِ: اسم مجرور بالواو وعلامة جره الكسرة الظاهرة، والجار والمجرور متعلقان بفعل محذوف تقديره: أُقسِمُ.
irab.en: wa: the wāw of oath, a preposition. al-ʿaṣri: genitive noun governed by the wāw, marked by kasra. The phrase attaches to an omitted verb: "I swear".

insight.en: The root ʿ-ṣ-r means to press or squeeze out. Time is constantly being "pressed" — each moment is squeezed out of your life and never returns. By swearing by al-ʿaṣr, the passing of time itself becomes the witness to the verdict that follows.

words.root_meaning: to press, squeeze out; an age or epoch; late afternoon

in_verse.note: swears by time itself as witness

2.structure_ar: جواب القسم: إنّ + اسمها (الإنسان) + اللام المزحلقة + خبرها شبه الجملة (في خسر). والجملة لا محل لها من الإعراب لأنها جواب القسم.
2.structure_en: Answer to the oath: inna + its subject (al-insān) + the emphatic lām + its predicate, the prepositional phrase (fī khusr).

segments.desc_ar: من الحروف المشبهة بالفعل: تنصب الاسم وترفع الخبر
segments.desc_en: One of the "verb-like particles": makes its subject accusative

words.sarf_note_ar: الحروف مبنية لا تتصرّف، فلا جذر لها ولا ميزان صرفي.
words.sarf_note_en: Particles are fixed (mabnī) and never inflect, so they have no root pattern (wazn).

irab.ar: حرف توكيد ونصب مبني على الفتح لا محل له من الإعراب.
irab.en: Particle of emphasis and accusative, built on fatḥa, with no grammatical case of its own.

insight.en: The verdict is stressed three times: by the oath (wal-ʿaṣr), by inna, and by the lām in lafī. The Qur'ān addresses a listener who would deny it — because no one naturally believes they are losing.

segments.desc_ar: لام قمرية؛ وأل هنا لاستغراق الجنس: كلّ إنسان
segments.desc_en: Moon-letter lām; "al" here covers the whole species: every human being

sarf.root_meaning: to be familiar, sociable, at ease with; to perceive
sarf.scholarly_note_ar: اختُلف في أصله: من «أنس» على وزن «فِعْلَان»، وقيل من «نسي» على وزن «إِفْعَان».
sarf.scholarly_note_en: Scholars differ: from ʾ-n-s (familiarity) on fiʿlān, or from n-s-y (forgetfulness) on ifʿān — man is both the sociable one and the forgetful one.

irab.ar: اسم إنّ منصوب وعلامة نصبه الفتحة الظاهرة على آخره.
irab.en: The subject (ism) of inna, accusative, marked by the visible fatḥa.

insight.title_en: Not one man — all of humanity
insight.en: The "al" here is generic (al-jinsiyya): it refers to the human species as a whole, not a specific person. That is exactly why an exception (illā…) can follow — you can only make an exception out of a complete category.

words.root_meaning: to be familiar, sociable, at ease with; to perceive

in_verse.note: covers all of humanity as a species

segments.desc_en: The lām of emphasis, "slid" onto the predicate

words.sarf_note_ar: كلاهما حرف مبني، فلا جذر لهما ولا ميزان.
words.sarf_note_en: Both are particles (mabnī): no root, no pattern.

irab.ar: اللام: اللام المزحلقة للتوكيد، حرف مبني على الفتح لا محل له من الإعراب. في: حرف جر مبني على السكون.
irab.en: la-: the "slid" lām of emphasis, no grammatical case. fī: preposition, built on sukūn.

insight.en: Grammarians call it al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa — the lām that slid. It belongs at the start of the sentence, but two emphasizers (inna and la-) may not stand side by side, so it slides onto the predicate. And note fī ("inside"): mankind is not near loss — it is immersed in it, contained within it.

sarf.root_meaning: to lose, suffer loss (esp. of capital in trade); to diminish

family.en: he lost this world and the next
and do not short the scale

irab.ar: اسم مجرور بـ«في» وعلامة جره الكسرة الظاهرة (تنوين الكسر)، والجار والمجرور متعلقان بمحذوف خبر إنّ.
irab.en: Genitive noun governed by fī, marked by kasra (with tanwīn). The phrase fī khusr attaches to an omitted predicate of inna.

insight.en: Khusr is indefinite (nakira) with tanwīn — not "the loss" but "a loss" so vast it is left undefined (tanwīn al-tahwīl). And khasira is a trader's word: your life is the capital, and every moment of time is currency being spent.

words.root_meaning: to lose, suffer loss (esp. of capital in trade); to diminish

3.structure_ar: استثناء: إلّا + المستثنى (الذين) + أربع جمل صلة متعاطفة: آمنوا، وعملوا الصالحات، وتواصوا بالحق، وتواصوا بالصبر.
3.structure_en: Exception: illā + the excepted (alladhīna) + four coordinated relative clauses — believe, do righteous deeds, counsel one another to truth, counsel one another to patience.

segments.desc_ar: تُخرج ما بعدها من حكم ما قبلها
segments.desc_en: Removes what follows from the ruling before it

words.sarf_note_en: A fixed particle — no morphological pattern.

irab.ar: أداة استثناء مبنية على السكون لا محل لها من الإعراب.
irab.en: Particle of exception, built on sukūn, with no grammatical case.

insight.en: One word lifts people out of a universal verdict. The exception is not by wealth, lineage or intellect — only by four qualities that follow, all of which are within anyone's reach.

in_verse.note: lifts the faithful out of universal loss

words.sarf_note_ar: الأسماء المبنية (كالأسماء الموصولة) لا تدخلها الأوزان الصرفية؛ فالصرف يختص بالأسماء المعربة والأفعال المتصرفة.
words.sarf_note_en: Built-in (mabnī) nouns such as relative pronouns are outside the scope of ṣarf, which deals only with inflecting nouns and verbs.

irab.ar: اسم موصول مبني على الفتح في محل نصب مستثنى بـ«إلّا».
irab.en: Relative pronoun, built on fatḥa, in the accusative position as the excepted (mustathnā).

insight.en: A relative pronoun is empty until its ṣila (relative clause) defines it. "Those who…" means nothing on its own — in this sūrah a person is identified not by name or tribe, but by what they believe and do.

segments.desc_ar: ضمير متصل في محل رفع فاعل، والألف بعده فارقة لا تُنطق
segments.desc_en: Verb subject ending (they); the final alif is silent (alif fāriqa)

sarf.root_meaning: safety, security, trust; to believe, have faith
sarf.word_type_en: Form IV perfect verb (augmented by one letter: hamza)

verb.meaning_of_form_en: Causative — to make or grant something

transformation.ar: أصله «أَأْمَنَ»: اجتمعت همزتان والثانية ساكنة، فأُبدلت الثانية ألفًا من جنس حركة الأولى فصار «آمَنَ».
transformation.en: Originally aʾmana: two hamzas met with the second one silent, so the second (the root's fāʾ) turned into a long alif — āmana.

family.en: the Granter of security (a Divine Name)

irab.ar: فعل ماضٍ مبني على الضم لاتصاله بواو الجماعة، والواو ضمير متصل مبني على السكون في محل رفع فاعل، والألف فارقة. والجملة صلة الموصول لا محل لها من الإعراب.
irab.en: Perfect verb built on ḍamma because of the attached wāw; the wāw is the subject pronoun (nominative position); the alif is silent. The clause is the ṣila of the relative pronoun and has no grammatical case.

insight.en: Form IV often means "to make/grant". From amina (to be safe) comes āmana: to trust someone so completely that you feel safe with them. Īmān is not mere information — it is a relationship of trust in which the heart finds security.

words.root_meaning: safety, security, trust; to believe, have faith

segments.desc_ar: ضمير متصل في محل رفع فاعل، والألف بعده فارقة لا تُنطق
segments.desc_en: Verb subject ending (they); the final alif is silent (alif fāriqa)

sarf.root_meaning: to work, act, do deeds with intention and effort

verb.meaning_of_form_en: Base form — the core meaning of the root

irab.ar: الواو: حرف عطف مبني على الفتح. عملوا: فعل ماضٍ مبني على الضم لاتصاله بواو الجماعة، والواو ضمير متصل في محل رفع فاعل، والألف فارقة. والجملة معطوفة على جملة «آمنوا» لا محل لها من الإعراب.
irab.en: wa: conjunction. ʿamilū: perfect verb built on ḍamma; the wāw is the subject pronoun; the alif is silent. The clause is coordinated with "āmanū" and has no grammatical case.

insight.en: Arabic has two words for doing: fiʿl (any act) and ʿamal (deliberate, sustained effort with intention). The Qur'ān pairs belief with ʿamal — faith must become a steady practice, not a single moment.

words.root_meaning: to work, act, do deeds with intention and effort

segments.desc_ar: لام شمسية: تُدغم اللام في الحرف التالي فيُشدَّد
segments.desc_en: Sun-letter lām: assimilated into the next letter (hence the shadda)
Adjective of an omitted noun: (the) righteous (deeds)

sarf.root_meaning: to be sound, right, fitting; to repair, set right
sarf.word_type_ar: اسم فاعل من «صَلَحَ» — جمع مؤنث سالم
sarf.word_type_en: Active participle of ṣalaḥa — feminine sound plural

irab.ar: مفعول به منصوب وعلامة نصبه الكسرة نيابةً عن الفتحة لأنه جمع مؤنث سالم.
irab.en: Direct object, accusative — but marked by kasra instead of fatḥa, because sound feminine plurals take kasra in the accusative.

insight.title_en: A dropped noun that widens the meaning
insight.en: Ṣāliḥāt is an adjective whose noun was left out: (al-aʿmāl) al-ṣāliḥāt, "(the) righteous (deeds)". Omitting the noun opens it to every kind of good. And ṣ-l-ḥ means "fitting, repairing" — a righteous deed fits its place and mends what is broken.

words.root_meaning: to be sound, right, fitting; to repair, set right

segments.desc_ar: ضمير متصل في محل رفع فاعل، والألف بعده فارقة لا تُنطق
segments.desc_en: Verb subject ending (they); the final alif is silent (alif fāriqa)

sarf.root_meaning: to enjoin, entrust, give lasting counsel; to bequeath
sarf.word_type_en: Form VI perfect verb (augmented by tā' and alif)

verb.meaning_of_form_en: Reciprocity — an action done mutually, to one another

rows.future_en: you all will counsel each other

transformation.ar: أصله «تَوَاصَيُوا»: تحرّكت الياء وانفتح ما قبلها فقُلبت ألفًا «تَوَاصَاوْا»، ثم حُذفت الألف لالتقاء الساكنين فصار «تَوَاصَوْا» على وزن «تَفَاعَوْا».
transformation.en: Originally tawāṣayū: the yā' (3rd radical) became an alif, which was then dropped to avoid two consecutive sukūns — leaving tawāṣaw on the pattern tafāʿaw.

family.en: and enjoined one another to mercy

irab.ar: الواو: حرف عطف مبني على الفتح. تواصوا: فعل ماضٍ مبني على الفتح المقدّر على الألف المحذوفة لالتقاء الساكنين، والواو ضمير متصل مبني على السكون في محل رفع فاعل، والألف فارقة. والجملة معطوفة على جملة الصلة لا محل لها من الإعراب.
irab.en: wa: conjunction. tawāṣaw: perfect verb, built on an implied fatḥa over the deleted alif; the wāw is the attached subject pronoun (nominative position); the final alif is silent. The clause is coordinated with the relative clause and has no grammatical case.

insight.en: Form VI (tafāʿala) expresses mutuality: everyone both gives and receives. Tawāṣaw is not "they lectured others" but "they counselled one another" — no one is only a preacher, and no one is only a listener. Waṣiyya is weighty, lasting counsel: the same word used for a dying person's final will.

words.root_meaning: to enjoin, entrust, give lasting counsel; to bequeath

segments.desc_en: Moon-letter lām: the lām is pronounced

sarf.root_meaning: to be true, firmly established, binding; a right or due
sarf.word_type_en: Triliteral noun (originally the maṣdar of ḥaqqa – yaḥiqqu)

transformation.ar: أصله «حَقْقٌ»: اجتمع حرفان متماثلان أولهما ساكن، فأُدغم الأول في الثاني فصار «حَقّ» — والشدّة تجمع العين واللام.
transformation.en: Originally ḥaqq-q: two identical letters met, the first silent, so they merged into one doubled letter. The shadda holds both the ʿayn and the lām of the pattern.

irab.ar: الباء: حرف جر مبني على الكسر. الحقِّ: اسم مجرور بالباء وعلامة جره الكسرة الظاهرة، والجار والمجرور متعلقان بالفعل «تواصوا».
irab.en: bi-: preposition. al-ḥaqqi: genitive noun, marked by kasra. The phrase attaches to the verb tawāṣaw.

insight.title_en: Truth that makes a claim on you
insight.en: Al-ḥaqq is what is firmly established and binding — truth that demands something of you. Al-Ḥāqqa, a name of the Day of Judgment, comes from the same root. Counselling with al-ḥaqq covers truth in belief and the rights owed to others.

words.root_meaning: to be true, firmly established, binding; a right or due

in_verse.note: firm truth in belief & rights owed

segments.desc_ar: ضمير متصل في محل رفع فاعل، والألف بعده فارقة لا تُنطق
segments.desc_en: Verb subject ending (they); the final alif is silent (alif fāriqa)

sarf.root_meaning: to enjoin, entrust, give lasting counsel; to bequeath
sarf.word_type_en: Form VI perfect verb (augmented by tā' and alif)

verb.meaning_of_form_en: Reciprocity — an action done mutually, to one another

rows.future_en: you all will counsel each other

transformation.ar: أصله «تَوَاصَيُوا»: تحرّكت الياء وانفتح ما قبلها فقُلبت ألفًا «تَوَاصَاوْا»، ثم حُذفت الألف لالتقاء الساكنين فصار «تَوَاصَوْا» على وزن «تَفَاعَوْا».
transformation.en: Originally tawāṣayū: the yā' (3rd radical) became an alif, which was then dropped to avoid two consecutive sukūns — leaving tawāṣaw on the pattern tafāʿaw.

family.en: and enjoined one another to mercy

irab.ar: الواو: حرف عطف مبني على الفتح. تواصوا: فعل ماضٍ مبني على الفتح المقدّر على الألف المحذوفة لالتقاء الساكنين، والواو ضمير متصل مبني على السكون في محل رفع فاعل، والألف فارقة. والجملة معطوفة على جملة الصلة لا محل لها من الإعراب.
irab.en: wa: conjunction. tawāṣaw: perfect verb, built on an implied fatḥa over the deleted alif; the wāw is the attached subject pronoun (nominative position); the final alif is silent. The clause is coordinated with the relative clause and has no grammatical case.

insight.en: The verse could have said "counselled one another to truth and patience". Repeating tawāṣaw makes each counsel its own independent act: urging truth and urging patience are two separate duties — and the second is needed precisely because standing for truth brings hardship.

words.root_meaning: to enjoin, entrust, give lasting counsel; to bequeath

segments.desc_ar: لام شمسية: تُدغم اللام في الحرف التالي فيُشدَّد
segments.desc_en: Sun-letter lām: assimilated into the next letter (hence the shadda)

sarf.root_meaning: to restrain, hold back, bind firmly; to persevere

irab.ar: الباء: حرف جر مبني على الكسر. الصبرِ: اسم مجرور بالباء وعلامة جره الكسرة الظاهرة، والجار والمجرور متعلقان بالفعل «تواصوا» الثاني.
irab.en: bi-: preposition. al-ṣabri: genitive noun, marked by kasra. The phrase attaches to the second tawāṣaw.

insight.en: Ṣ-b-r means to hold back, to bind something firmly in place. Ṣabr is not passive waiting: it is holding the self firm upon obedience, away from sin, and steady through hardship. (The shadda on ṣ comes from the sun-letter "al", not from the root.)

words.root_meaning: to restrain, hold back, bind firmly; to persevere
